signatures.description: Implement sparse conditional constant propagation (SCCP) over a reducible CFG with the lattice {undefined, const, overdefined} and an executable-edge worklist, so values flowing only from never-taken branches never poison a phi merge. The pass must reach a fixpoint without oscillating when a phi predecessor set shrinks after an edge becomes unreachable, fold conditional branches whose operand is provably constant, and refuse to fold constants whose only evidence is a loop with a runtime trip count.
